verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer's docs list creating media "including PDFs, slide decks, spreadsheets, images, and videos" and processing image files in a sandboxed VM, so prompt-driven image creation is a documented capability. Both claims are single-line mentions. Editing is only implied by generic file processing, and nothing shows a dedicated text-to-image or image-editing model. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language image generation and editing workflows, evidence of prompt-based image editing beyond generic file processing, independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
